name: Love Nocturna
source:
You stumble into a town, enshrouded and plagued, and straight into a beast's clutches. Can you earn your escape?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你誤入一座籠罩在陰霾裡、災厄纏身的小鎮，一頭撞進了野獸的利爪。你能為自己掙得一條逃生之路嗎？

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian App[/url]］
